name: update-status-minimal
description: S→C update.status reply (protocol 1.8, SPEC §7, D-09): the minimal shape — only the two required fields. This is the "extension has never connected AND no previous update attempt" case: `extVersion` and `lastUpdate` are ABSENT, not null (the skip-when-absent convention every optional field in this protocol follows, cf. TabEl `icon`/`groupId`). A missing marker is the NORMAL case, never an error. The canonical re-encode must not materialise either key.
